The method / Look legitimate online / Step 2
ACTION 18 OF 32 · PHASE 05

Set up the domain, email and SEO foundation

Make the business findable and look trustworthy without promising rankings.

WHEN TO DO THISOnce the name is selected; before asking people to visit your website.ESTIMATED WORK TIME1–2 hours
↗
Your one job

Make the business findable and look trustworthy without promising rankings.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Secure the preferred domain and set a professional contact email.

  2. 02

    Map actual searches customers use: service+location, problems, questions and brand variations.

  3. 03

    Plan a focused homepage and service/location pages only where you genuinely operate.

  4. 04

    Use accurate titles, headings, meta descriptions, crawlable links and canonical URLs; prepare Search Console and sitemap after launch.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Create a practical SEO plan for [BUSINESS] in [COUNTRY/CITIES]. Group customer search intent into core service, locations we genuinely serve, questions and brand. Recommend homepage and service pages with specific intent, headings, proof needed, title/meta draft and internal links. Include Google Search Console, sitemap, indexing and local-SEO checks. Never guarantee a ranking or create location pages for places we don't serve.
03

Finish with this

Domain/contact inventory and an SEO page/keyword map.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Domain/email ownership documented
  • Every page targets a real customer question
  • No fabricated service areas or rank promises
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Mass-producing thin pages for islands or districts you cannot serve.
